title: indigo_mount_synscan: X_ENCODER_POSITION renamed to X_MOUNT_ENCODER_POSITION
description: Rename the custom property X_ENCODER_POSITION of indigo_mount_synscan to X_MOUNT_ENCODER_POSITION so it follows the X_MOUNT_ naming of the driver's other custom properties (owner, 2026-11-22: 'premenuj to'). Items RA and DEC, group, permissions and values stay as they are; X_POLARSCOPE is not touched. Scope: the property name in indigo_drivers/mount_synscan/indigo_mount_synscan.driver (and comments naming it), regenerated .c/.h/_main.c, indigo_docs/PROPERTIES.md, indigo_test/integration/test_mount_synscan_simulator.c, indigo_test/hardware/test_mount_synscan_hw.c, and any other reference in the repository outside .factory2. Driver version 32 -> 33. Recorded non-interactive simulator run with tools/run_driver_test.py mount_synscan; no hardware run (the hardware suite is only updated to the new name and must still compile). The property was added on 2026-11-19 (2f68b2e12), is read-only and not saved in the configuration, and is in no release.

outcome.summary: Diff master...HEAD (d75c18c73) is only the rename. .driver: name string in the define, one comment, version 32 -> 33; the number MOUNT_ENCODER_POSITION declaration (items RA/DEC, group, permission, hidden logic) and X_POLARSCOPE untouched. Regenerating the .driver with the unchanged build/bin/indigo_generator into a scratch directory gives indigo_mount_synscan.c, .h and _main.c byte-identical to the worktree; the .c diff is DRIVER_VERSION 0x03000020 -> 0x03000021, the name string and the comment. PROPERTIES.md: custom list re-sorted and still alphabetical, description uses the new name. Simulator and hardware tests change only the define and comments. README and TEST_SUMMARY.md: only the 16:10 3.0.0.32 simulator record replaced by 2026-11-22 19:25 3.0.0.33 mac arm64 simulator 144/144 OK; the AZGTi 21/21 record kept. git grep -w X_ENCODER_POSITION outside .factory2 finds nothing. No blank lines added in function bodies, MIGRATION_STATUS.md untouched and consistent (144 / 21), no files added so no Xcode change. Not verified by me: the test run itself (no tests run in review). No defects.
